meta.name: agent-browser
meta.description: Browse the web for any task — research topics, read articles, interact with web apps, fill forms, take screenshots, extract data, and test web pages. Use whenever a browser would be useful, not just when the user explicitly asks.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用浏览器自动完成网页浏览、数据提取和测试
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用代码控制浏览器完成各种网页任务
copy.tagline_en: Automate web browsing, data extraction, and testing with a browser
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to programmatically control a browser for web tasks

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 可以自动打开网页、读取页面内容、点击元素、填写表单、截图、提取数据,并通过保存的登录状态操作需要登录的网站。
howto.when: 当浏览器对完成任务有帮助时就会触发,不限于你明确说要用浏览器;例如查资料、填表、截图等场景。

say.text: 打开 example.com 并截个图
say.note: 会用浏览器打开页面并保存截图。

say.text: 把这个表单里的邮箱和密码填好并提交
say.note: 会读取表单元素,填入内容并点击提交。

say.text: 提取这个页面上所有商品的标题和链接
say.note: 会列出匹配元素的文本和属性。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude can open web pages, read their content, click elements, fill forms, take screenshots, extract data, and use saved login state to operate websites that require authentication.
howto.when_en: Triggers whenever a browser would be useful, not only when explicitly asked — e.g., for research, form filling, screenshots, or any web task.

say_en.text: Open example.com and take a screenshot.
say_en.note: Opens the page and saves a screenshot.

say_en.text: Fill in the email and password on this form and submit it.
say_en.note: Reads form elements, fills them, and clicks submit.

say_en.text: Extract the titles and links of all products on this page.
say_en.note: Lists text and attributes of matching elements.
